description: Bugfix verification benchmark v1 for Forge runtime guardrails. Tasks focus on Bug Fix Ledger, verify-before-final behavior, verification command classification, and evidence artifacts.

tasks.prompt: Fix the failing calculator add bug and verify the fix before final.
tasks.expected_artifact: calculator.py add returns a + b and verification passes
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; text = Path('calculator.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert 'return a + b' in text; assert ledger['guard_triggered']; assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger['verify_required'] is False; assert any(event.get('event') == 'bug_fix_guard_triggered' for event in trace)"

tasks.prompt: Fix the failing calculator add regression, recover after a failed verification, and finish only after tests pass.
tasks.expected_artifact: failed verification keeps guard active until corrected patch passes
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; text = Path('calculator.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert 'return a + b' in text; assert ledger['guard_triggered']; assert ledger['failing_evidence']; assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger['verify_required'] is False"

tasks.prompt: Reproduce the calculator add failure, fix it, and verify the regression test passes.
tasks.expected_artifact: ledger records reproduction command, failure evidence, and passing evidence
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert 'pytest' in ledger['reproduction_command']; assert ledger['failing_evidence']; assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger['verification_command']"

tasks.prompt: Fix the typo in README only.
tasks.expected_artifact: README typo is fixed without requiring code verification
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; readme = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert 'typo for the docs-only benchmark' in readme; assert not ledger.get('guard_triggered'); assert report['stop_reason'] == 'final_answer_returned'"

tasks.prompt: Add a short usage note to the README.
tasks.expected_artifact: non-bug README edit is not guarded as a bugfix
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; readme = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert 'Usage note: run tests before release.' in readme; assert not ledger.get('active'); assert not ledger.get('guard_triggered')"

tasks.prompt: Fix the calculator add bug; do not accept fake verification commands.
tasks.expected_artifact: echo test does not satisfy verification and real pytest is required
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert ledger['guard_triggered']; assert ledger['verification_command'].startswith('python -m pytest'); assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger['verify_required'] is False"

tasks.prompt: Fix the calculator add bug and use a lightweight Python compile verification before final.
tasks.expected_artifact: py_compile counts as verification for Python edit
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; assert 'py_compile' in ledger['verification_command']; assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger['verify_required'] is False"

tasks.prompt: Fix the calculator add bug and run the verbose regression test so long verification output is preserved as an artifact.
tasks.expected_artifact: long verification output is saved and linked from ledger/report
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; artifacts = report.get('output_artifacts', []); assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger.get('passing_artifact'); assert any(item.get('path') == ledger['passing_artifact'] for item in artifacts); assert Path(ledger['passing_artifact']).read_text(encoding='utf-8').count('LONG-VERIFICATION-LINE') >= 100"
